decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (CS/070487/01, CS/070487/02, CS/070487/03, CS/070478/04, planning statement dated January 2014 and design and access statement dated January 2014  Received on 30/01/2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The four porta-cabin buildings hereby permitted shall be removed and the land restored to its former condition on or before the expiration of two years from the date of this permission in accordance with a scheme of work submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Retrospective installation of four porta-cabin buildings
